name: Castrillo de la Vega (Spain)
description: Vertical tricolour of red, white and yellow, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Castrillo de la Vega (a tree, a castle and grapes above waves).
history: Municipal flag of Castrillo de la Vega; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Castrillo de la Vega arms — tree, castle and grapes above waves
